data.one_liner: Run and manage scripts defined in pubspec.yaml or rps.yaml from the command line
data.what_it_does: RPS lets you define shell commands in your pubspec or a separate rps.yaml file and execute them with a simple CLI. It supports nested commands, hooks, platform‑specific scripts, positional arguments and references.
use_when: You want a lightweight script runner without writing separate Dart scripts
You need to keep long flutter or build commands in pubspec for CI or local use
You want to share scripts across a team via pubspec
avoid_when: You need complex task orchestration with dependencies beyond simple shell commands
You are building a full CI/CD pipeline that requires advanced tooling
strengths: Simple YAML configuration, no code generation
Built‑in hooks and references for reusable workflows
weaknesses: Limited to shell commands, no Dart API integration
No advanced dependency graph or parallel execution
Requires Dart SDK and global activation
data.minimal_example:
```yaml
scripts:
  build:
    web: flutter build web --flavor production -t lib/main.dart
    android: flutter build apk --flavor production -t lib/main.dart
```
